verdict.rationale: Ramp documents multiple AI-driven accounting automations that directly speed up book closing: auto-categorization synced to ERPs, real-time bidirectional ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries, AI agents handling auto-coding/approval/payment, and invoice-to-payment automation with 7x fewer clicks than Bill.com, plus multi-entity consolidated reporting. Customer proof points (Studs, AIRCO) support efficiency gains, though they focus on tool consolidation/onboarding rather than a specific close-cycle time metric. Missing for 10: an independent or third-party benchmark quantifying month-end close time reduction, and community corroboration specifically about faster book closing (only general expense-tracking praise exists).
